reasons.DELIVERY_FAILING: Discord is rejecting messages from this webhook; retrying. Responses are still being collected.
reasons.WEBHOOK_DELETED: The webhook was deleted on Discord (or its token was reset). Responses are collected, but no notifications are sent: create the webhook again.
reasons.BOT_NOT_IN_GUILD: The bot is not on this webhook's server. Responses are collected; add the bot back to manage notifications.
reasons.CHANNEL_UNAVAILABLE: The bot can no longer see the webhook's channel (deleted or hidden). Responses are still collected.
reasons.MISSING_PERMISSIONS: The bot lost Manage Webhooks in the channel. Responses are collected; restore the permission so notifications don't stop.
